_step: Music School Phase 1 step 2 (family songbooks / Ancient Echoes)
_naming: Ancient Echoes everywhere (never the old name). Tune ids below are CANONICAL (Kai, Nov 1): code, tunes.json and tools/songbook_src/<fam>/<id>.txt use exactly these.
_changelog: Nov 1 (Kai): Ancient Echoes page shows only heard tunes + ONE sleeping pebble; ancient_page.png replaced by top/row/bottom pieces, no fixed grid.

Nov 4 (Pixal/Jay): final 19. The 8 new tune icons are the real art; the 8 dropped tunes and the 3 never-shipping ones (night_bald_mountain, jesu_joy blocked; overture_1812 held) have no icon. Tune icons = exactly the 19 shipped tunes (tools/test-songbook.js).

layout.page_flow: items = heard tunes (order heard) + ONE slot_sleeping pebble (omit the pebble when that family has no unheard tune left). rows = ceil(items/4). page height = 46 + 42*rows + 12. Item k at (18 + (k%4)*34, 53 + floor(k/4)*42). Never draw extra empty slots.
layout.page_play_hint: tap a met icon = Echo version plays; icon_pressed_ring at (-2,-2) of the icon while it plays
layout.emblem_title: ancient_emblem.png left of the "Ancient Echoes" title text
